blurb: Guests can enjoy craft beers, gin, cocktails, and food at the brewery and distillery. The venue hosts various events including trivia nights, comedy shows, BBQs, and seasonal celebrations. Food offerings include items like bison burgers, bratwurst, soft pretzels, and hot dogs.
extraNote: Trivia reservations cost $15 and include a guaranteed spot and a jug of beer or cocktail · Events are first come, first serve unless reservation is made
